notes.title: Hotfix 3 - Found another soft-lock
notes.content:
Hi anyone. Some small fixes for big problems:

[list]
[*] Fixed "hard mode unlocked" button sometimes not becoming active which caused a soft-lock. 
[*] Fixed missing SFX on defeating the secret boss. 
[*] Set the cursor to be confined in the game window. 
[/list]
Thanks all. If you find bugs please tell us. It helps us out a lot.

notes.title: Hotfix 2: Purgatory bugs!
notes.content:
Hi any and all,

Just another quick patch to fix some bugs in purgatory:

[list]
[*] Fix for Purgatory tutorial screen continue button not being active and causing a soft lock. 
[*] Fix for gamepad controls bugging out during the secret boss fight.
[*] Upgrading a weapon in purgatory mode should now refill the ammo of the upgraded weapon as intended.
[*] Soul count is now properly displayed in the post game endless stage.
[/list]
Thanks to everyone playing and reporting bugs. Keep telling us about them and we will keep squishing them.

notes.title: Labour day hotfix
notes.content:
Hi all,

Quick fix for some annoying bugs that have been bothering players:

[list]
[*] Tabbing out of the application while a menu is open shouldn't reset the game or let the game play behind the pause menu anymore.
[*] Purgatory upgrade screen will no longer accept gamepad inputs until the screen is fully open. 
[*] Chapter 3 and Chapter 5 now play the correct music.
[*] The souls collected Steam stat now properly increments by the value of the coin collected. 
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who spotted bugs for us. Keep them coming.

notes.title: BACKFIRE is Available Now!
notes.content: [p]Hello anyone![/p][p]We are happy to announce that BACKFIRE has now been reborn on the PC! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4BkqQQ2fZds&ab_channel=SQYD.studio"][/dynamiclink]We've worked hard remastering our game for PC. This new version of BACKFIRE:[/p][list][*][p]Has new spooky lighting [/p][/*][*][p]Supports gamepad, mouse, and touchscreen controls[/p][/*][*][p]Has a handful of Steam achievements to discover and,[/p][/*][*][p]Plays great on the Steam Deck[/p][/*][/list][p]We are very proud of our work here- and we hope it satisfies anybody looking for an atmospheric and challenging arcade shooter. It’s very exciting to bring it back to market and get people playing it again.[/p][p]To celebrate, BACKFIRE will be 25% off for the next two weeks. That's until Friday September 12th. [/p][p]We aren't done yet- the mobile version of BACKFIRE will be returning soon. Keep an eye on our website, [url="https://sqyd.studio/"]SQYD.studio[/url], for details.[/p][p]As artists, nothing compares to seeing people interact with the thing we’ve made. Thank you to everyone who’s played and supported BACKFIRE in the past and to everyone and anyone who will in the future. It fills our hearts.[/p]

notes.title: BACKFIRE - Launch Date Announcement!
notes.content: [p]Hi anyone! We are happy to announce that BACKFIRE's PC port is almost done. It's taken a bit longer then planned but all the game features are in place and we are settling into testing and a final polish pass. [/p][p]BACKFIRE will arrive on Steam on [b]August 29th, 2025![/b] That's just over one month away.[/p][p]New features in the upgraded BACKFIRE:[/p][list][*][p]New 2D lighting gives the game an oppressive atmosphere in line with the original vision[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple control styles - Touchscreen, Gamepad, and Mouse & Keyboard[/p][/*][*][p]Tested on Steam Deck (may or may not be verified at launch, but it for sure works)[/p][/*][/list][p]If you have never played BACKFIRE on mobile (currently unavailable but it will return), it's a hardcore arcade shooter built around a backward firing control scheme. It's built to be a challenge, and it highlights its atmosphere with horror themes and a dynamic soundtrack. We are biased, obviously, but we like our game- maybe you will too. [/p][p]In SQYD.studio news: we've recently made changes to our approach to game development. [url="https://sqyd.studio/2025/07/24/at-our-pace-sqyd-studio-is-a-hobby-again/"]You can read about those changes here.[/url] In short: we are going to treat our studio as a hobby, not a business, and it's going to help us make better games.[/p][p]We appreciate everyone who's played the BACKFIRE Demo and shared their feedback with us. We are very excited to have BACKFIRE back in the hands of players again. See you on [b]August 29th![/b][/p]
